
# Local LLM coding instructions

- Execute simple file operations immediately.
- Do not write lengthy plans for simple tasks.
- Do not repeat file reads unnecessarily.
- Never speculate about previous tool operations.
- Use file-editing tools for file modifications.
- Preserve existing file content unless explicitly
  instructed to replace it.
- Prefer minimal targeted edits over whole-file rewrites.
- Do not ask for information already provided.
- After successful execution, give a one-sentence
  confirmation.
